# Genlook: written approval of Garrab's use (received 15 Nov 2026)

From Thibault (Genlook), in reply to Asser's email of 15 Nov 2026:

> Yes, confirmed: running a managed try-on service for many brands under one Genlook account, and billing them your own monthly fee, is allowed. I've made it explicit in our Terms (section 6, "Building on and reselling the Try-On API"): https://genlook.app/terms
>
> The only limits: don't share or resell your API keys, and don't resell raw API access as a pass-through API. Your setup (your backend, your widget, your brand) is exactly the intended case. On data, you act as the brands' processor and we're your subprocessor under our DPA (https://genlook.app/dpa). Deleting each photo after the preview with a 1 day retention is great.
>
> Startup program: we can give you free credits to test quality on your brands' catalogs, plus a free first month on a plan when you launch. Just send me your Genlook account email.
>
> Volume: 150 brands at a few hundred previews each is roughly 45k try-ons a month. The Scale plan fits: $300/month for 20,000 credits, then $0.015 per try-on beyond that, so around $675/month at 45k. You can start on Growth or Starter and move up as brands onboard.

Keep the original email in the inbox as well. Lawyer: review alongside the Terms §6 and the DPA.
